issuanceInfo.title: Request your digital attestation
issuanceInfo.description: We will guide you step by step so you can get your attestation and save it in your wallet. It only takes a few minutes.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.title: What is the Digital Identity Wallet?
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.description: A digital identity wallet lets you keep and present your attestations from your own device, without relying on passwords or paper.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature1.title: Top security
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature1.descripti: Your attestations are protected and only you decide when to share them.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature2.title: Always with you
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature2.descripti: Save your attestation in your wallet and present it from the device you prefer.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature3.title: You are in control
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature3.descripti: You decide what to share and with whom, every time.
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature4.title: Officially valid
issuanceInfo.whatIsIt.feature4.descripti: Attestations issued and checked in line with European digital identity rules.
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.title: How it works
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step1.title: Verify your identity
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step1.descriptio: Confirm who you are securely to start the process.
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step2.title: Receive your attestation
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step2.descriptio: You will receive your digital attestation.
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step3.title: Save it in your wallet
issuanceInfo.howItWorks.step3.descriptio: Add it to your wallet and it is ready to use.
